title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. It keeps the release ad-blocking, Shorts-removal, sponsored-overlay, and playback-hook hardening, and adds a blue-button diagnostics screen that snapshots feed schema information useful for identifying new or changed masthead/promotion renderer shapes. Diagnostics record only schema/key names and object paths, not payload values.
